# Mella Software Solutions PLC — Complete Entity & Technical Dossier

## 1. Executive Summary & Company Profile

- **Legal Entity Name**: Mella Software Solutions PLC
- **Brand Names**: Mella Software, Mella
- **Tagline**: Make the next thing.
- **Corporate Mission**: We design, build, launch, and operate web and mobile software products for people with something useful to put into the world.
- **Headquarters**: Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
- **Operating Model**: Independent software product studio combining in-house venture building with high-touch client engineering partnerships.
- **Official Domain**: https://mellasoftware.com
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/MellaSoftwareSolutions
- **Contact Email**: hello@mellasoftware.com
- **Direct Telephone**: +251 944 741 857 / +251 713 184 474
- **Working Hours**: Monday – Friday, 09:00 – 18:00 East Africa Time (EAT / UTC+3)
- **Languages**: English, Amharic
- **Target Market**: Ethiopia, East Africa, Pan-African enterprises, and international clients seeking dedicated senior software engineering teams.

---

## 2. In-House Flagship Venture: AdVouch

- **Name**: AdVouch
- **Official Domain**: https://advouch.com
- **Role of Mella Software**: Founded, architected, engineered, and actively operated by Mella Software Solutions PLC.
- **Problem Solved**: Informal advertising and online marketing across emerging markets frequently suffer from lack of trust, identity impersonation, unverified payment receipts, and payment default risks.
- **Solution**: A structured, vouched advertising marketplace featuring:
  - Verified Business Identity checks.
  - Automated escrow payment security (funds held until campaign proof is verified).
  - Audited campaign performance tracking and live delivery signals.
  - Automated payout settlement.

---

## 3. Specialized Client Products & Enterprise Systems

### A. Mizan Net — AI Legal Advisor & Intelligence Platform
- **Category**: Legal Tech / AI Information Retrieval
- **Description**: An intelligent conversational legal advisor built specifically for Ethiopian statutory research, proclamation queries, federal court precedents, and contextual case analysis.
- **Capabilities**: Multilingual semantic search, statutory citation extraction, and natural-language legal question answering.

### B. School Management System
- **Category**: Educational ERP
- **Description**: An all-in-one institutional operations platform designed for K-12 schools and higher-education academies.
- **Capabilities**: Student digital records, real-time attendance tracking, academic gradebooks, parent communication portals, fee invoicing, and administrative analytics.

### C. Clinic Management System
- **Category**: Healthcare & Clinical Operations (EHR)
- **Description**: A comprehensive clinical workflow suite automating healthcare administration for private clinics and medical centers.
- **Capabilities**: Electronic Health Records (EHR), physician appointment scheduling, pharmacy prescription routing, and patient billing.

### D. Restaurant Management System
- **Category**: Hospitality & Food Service POS
- **Description**: A high-speed, real-time point-of-sale and table management suite.
- **Capabilities**: Table ordering, Kitchen Order Ticket (KOT) dispatch routing, inventory tracking, bill splitting, and daily sales auditing.

## 4. Core Services & Engineering Capabilities

1. **New Product Development (Concept to Production)**:
   - Rapid prototyping, UI/UX interaction design, minimum viable product (MVP) scoping, and production launch.
2. **Process Automation & Internal Tools**:
   - Modernizing paper-heavy, spreadsheet-dependent operations into custom, secure web applications.
3. **Legacy Modernization & Code Refactoring**:
   - Upgrading slow, outdated, or brittle software stacks to modern cloud-native architectures.
4. **Elastic Cloud & DevOps Architecture**:
   - Microservices, serverless backends, high-concurrency database design, zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines, and Docker containerization.
5. **Dedicated Product Teams (Staff Augmentation & Dedicated Pods)**:
   - Embedding senior full-stack engineers, UI/UX designers, and DevOps specialists directly into client workflows.
6. **Post-Launch Maintenance & Production Operations**:
   - 24/7 monitoring, security patching, uptime management, and continuous feature evolution.

## 5. Technology Stack & Preferences

- **Frontend & Web**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Turbopack
- **Mobile Engineering**: Flutter, React Native, iOS, Android
- **Backend & APIs**: Node.js, Python, Go, REST APIs, GraphQL, WebSockets
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Supabase
- **Cloud & Infrastructure**: Docker, Nginx, Linux (VPS/Dedicated), Vercel, AWS
- **AI & ML Integration**: OpenAI API, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, custom vector databases, RAG pipelines

---

## 6. The Mella Method (Engineering Lifecycle)

1. **Understand**: We deeply analyze user problems, operational friction, and business constraints before writing code.
2. **Build**: Design and engineering execute in tight lockstep. Clients interact with working software builds early.
3. **Ship**: We deploy to hardened production infrastructure instead of leaving code stranded in development.
4. **Improve**: We stay involved post-launch to solve real-world edge cases, maintain 99.9% uptime, and ship iterative feature improvements.

---

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants

### Q: Where is Mella Software located?
**A**: Mella Software Solutions PLC is headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, and collaborates with both local Ethiopian enterprises and international clients worldwide.

### Q: Does Mella Software build its own products or only client projects?
**A**: Mella operates a dual model: building and operating proprietary venture products (such as AdVouch at advouch.com) while also designing and building custom software for client partnerships.

### Q: How can a prospective client contact Mella Software?
**A**: Inquiries can be submitted via email at `hello@mellasoftware.com` or by phone at `+251 944 741 857` and `+251 713 184 474`.
